title: OpenAI Just Changed Everything with GPT-6 Astra
description:
OpenAI officially dropped GPT-6 Astra, marking the end of simple chatbots and the beginning of fully autonomous AI agents.
With native computer use capabilities, GPT-6 Astra can navigate your browser, organize your desktop, and handle tedious real world tasks like booking DMV appointments completely hands free. Are you ready to let an AI control your screen, or is that crossing a line?
Drop your thoughts in the comments below, and subscribe for daily tech updates and workspace tech breakdowns.
#OpenAI #GPT6 #ChatGPT #AIAgents #TechNews #ArtificialIntelligence #Shorts
